basic_info.description: Iconic mixed-use building in the heart of Pacific Heights! 3100 California Street presents a rare chance to own a prominent corner property with three income-generating units in one of San Francisco's most prestigious neighborhoods. This stately Edwardian sits proudly at the intersection of California and Lyon, surrounded by leafy streets and upscale boutiques. The building features two spacious residential flats and a street-level commercial space, all awash with natural light from large, graceful windows. The residences showcase classic San Francisco character soaring ceilings, period moldings, and hardwood floors paired with flexible layouts for modern living. The commercial space is occupied by a thriving bodega with a secure lease through 2033 and built-in rent escalations. Both residential units are tenant-occupied, providing immediate revenue with significant upside potential. Close to the Presidio, Laurel Village, and the vibrant shops and restaurants along Sacramento Street, 3100 California offers an exceptional blend of location, stability, and future growth. A rare investment opportunity in a prime San Francisco neighborhood!
